quests.title: Night Fill, Milsons Point
quests.blurb: Ten to six, nobody in the building but us and a radio that gets one station. Somebody has been taking things and they know our roster, which means they come in off the late train at Milsons Point.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
$38 of what they took, back

quests.title: The Window Above Tempe
quests.blurb: I live above the platform at Tempe and I know this line by sound. Something in the rhythm changed about a month ago and everyone I tell thinks I am mad. Ride it and tell me whether I am mad.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Coalcliff
quests.blurb: 27 years in the Coalcliff market. The bays are not allocated, they are *known*, and since Thursdays somebody has decided that knowing does not count, and they keep sending a different bloke.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$48 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Victoria Cross
quests.blurb: The clock on the Victoria Cross platform has been four minutes fast since I got here and every relief who comes through wants to fix it. Do not fix it. Find out who set it that way, before they retire.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to North Sydney, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Concord West
quests.blurb: A dog meets the 5:40 at Concord West every weekday and nobody gets off for it. Four months of this. I have decided it is not going to be a sad story. Find out whose it is.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Museum
quests.blurb: Up four hundred over eleven weeks on the Museum delay market. You cannot beat a delay book unless you can see the roster, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. Think about who can see the roster.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$43 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of UNSW High Street
quests.blurb: The last one through UNSW High Street carries four people and one of them is always asleep. Ride it to Randwick, photograph the platform with nobody on it, and come back and tell me the place still exists when there is no one in it.

steps.label: ride the late one to Randwick
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Town Hall Tap-Off
quests.blurb: Somebody taps on at Town Hall at half six and never taps off. Same card, 9 months running. Ride the run they ride and find where a person gets off this network without a gate seeing them.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The QVB Order
quests.blurb: I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at QVB. Since the long weekend they have not turned up, and nobody will put it in writing. Go and knock.

steps.label: order one at the QVB kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $40 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Robin Thomas
quests.blurb: The board at Robin Thomas says four minutes. It has said four minutes since before the merge and it is a lie about a third of the time. Stand under it, time it, and bring me numbers instead of feelings.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Newtown
quests.blurb: Somebody lost something off the Newtown line on the long weekend and has not come for it, which never happens. Find out why not.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$54 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Telopea
quests.blurb: Speakerphone. Thursdays, Telopea to town, speakerphone. I have made eye contact eleven times and it has achieved nothing.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Bulli Shortcut
quests.blurb: Every courier has a route that is not on a map and mine goes through Bulli. They have started locking one end. Go and find out whether it is locked forever or just locked today.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$56, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Fairfield
quests.blurb: We own the track between midnight and four and in that window we are the only people in this city doing anything real. Somebody keeps walking through my possession at Fairfield. Find them before a grinder does.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Strathfield Regular
quests.blurb: Same stool since before I bought the place off Strathfield road. Gone since the long weekend, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. I would like to know whether to keep the stool.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, Hurlstone Park
quests.blurb: People have started parking on the grass at Hurlstone Park because of one abandoned car, and nobody will put it in writing. Photograph it, and the date on the ticket, so somebody can be embarrassed by it.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$42 in fines nobody is going to collect

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Mount Colah
quests.blurb: Council pays me to paint over things and last week I painted over something good. There is another one near Mount Colah that I am scheduled to kill on a Tuesday. Photograph it first.

steps.label: the wall, before they get to it
photograph it properly, not a phone-in-a-hurry job
show me

quests.title: The Hill Above Paddy's Markets
quests.blurb: There is a bench on the hill above Paddy's Markets I have watched from a moving bus about fourteen thousand times. I am not going to stop — that is not the kind of person I turned out to be. So you go, at the back of seven, when the light is worth it.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for
$47, because I am paying you for it

quests.title: Contesting It at International Airport
quests.blurb: Two hundred and eighty-five dollars at International Airport for a thing the sign did not say, because the sign is not there. The form wants evidence. Go and photograph the absence.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Juniors Kingsford
quests.blurb: A metre of dirt between the fence and the footpath at Juniors Kingsford, dead for 14 years and not dead now. Council mows on the fifteenth and does not know what is in it. Stand near it and stop the man with the whipper snipper.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: The Window Above Rouse Hill
quests.blurb: 24 years above Rouse Hill. I do not hear the trains any more, which means I hear it instantly when one of them is wrong. Since a wet Monday the joins sound different.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Waratah Mills
quests.blurb: Five in the morning at Waratah Mills, in the dark, unloading a van by feel. The bloke in the next bay has started arriving at four to take half my frontage. I need a witness and I need them at four.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour

quests.title: The Clock at Edmondson Park
quests.blurb: Somebody set the Edmondson Park clock that way on purpose and everyone who knows why is nearly gone. The old crew drink near Macquarie Fields on a wet Monday. Go and ask, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Macquarie Fields, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Niagara Park
quests.blurb: Sits at the yellow line at Niagara Park at quarter to six, waits, then walks off on its own. Half the platform knows and nobody has done anything, including me, and nobody will put it in writing.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Narwee
quests.blurb: I run a small book on things that are not races — weather, delays, whether the half six out of Narwee runs on time. Somebody is beating it by information, not luck. Ride the run they ride.

the two who follow you off it
$45 back off the book
